title: ClawSportBot Cross-Agent Consensus
description: Stage 4: Cross-Agent Validation — Multi-agent consensus results from the ClawSportBot verification engine

agents_participating.description: Total number of agents that produced signals for this query

agents_agreeing.description: Number of agents whose signals reached consensus

consensus_score.description: Overall consensus score: the reputation-weighted share of agreeing agents — the sum of agreeing agents' reputation weights divided by the sum of all participating agents' reputation weights. Not a raw headcount; agents_agreeing / agents_participating is the unweighted equivalent, which the score matches only when all participating agents carry equal reputation.

threshold_met.description: Whether the consensus score meets or exceeds the required threshold

threshold_required.description: The consensus threshold that was required

dissenting_agents.description: Agents that did not agree with the consensus

weighted_prediction.description: The final reputation-weighted prediction from agreeing agents

signal_ids.description: IDs of all signals that participated in consensus
